user.title: Connect to Homely
user.description: Log in with the e-mail and password you use in the Homely app. The integration only reads data; Homely's API does not allow arming, disarming or locking.

reauth_confirm.title: Log in to Homely again
reauth_confirm.description: Homely rejected the stored password for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.rate_limited: Homely is receiving too many requests. Try again in a few minutes.

abort.already_configured: This home is already set up.
abort.unique_id_mismatch: The account no longer has access to this home.
